articles.제목: Milestone for Urenco USA expansion project
articles.원문 요약: The start of production in the sixth cascade of new uranium enrichment capacity at Urenco USA's National Enrichment Facility in New Mexico means 75% of the ongoing capacity expansion has been completed.

Agreement signed on second Polish nuclear power plant
articles.원문 요약: Poland's Ministry of Energy, Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe and Polska Grupa Energetyczna have signed an agreement defining the division of tasks and principles of cooperation in preparing the construction of the country's second nuclear power plant.

articles.제목: NND applies to take over Kjeller nuclear facilities
articles.원문 요약: Norwegian Nuclear Decommissioning has submitted a licence application to the country's nuclear regulator to take over responsibility for the nuclear facilities at Kjeller from the Institute of Energy Engineering ahead of their decommissioning.

articles.제목: Czech SMR environmental impact assessment submitted
articles.원문 요약: ČEZ has submitted the Environmental Impact Assessment documentation to the Ministry of the Environment for its Rolls-Royce SMR small modular reactor project in Temelín.
